name: WhatsApp No Contact
tagline: Message anyone on WhatsApp without saving their number
description:
WhatsApp No Contact is a tiny, handy tool that lets you start a WhatsApp conversation with any phone number, without first saving that number as a contact. Just type in the number and jump straight into the chat.

It's perfect for one-off messages to businesses, delivery drivers, or new acquaintances when you don't want to clutter up your contact list.
